meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 这个技能会分析你对 NanoClaw 项目的自定义修改，生成一份可重用的迁移指南。之后，它会用这份指南在干净的官方代码上重新应用你的修改，避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你需要将自定义过的 NanoClaw 分支升级到上游最新版本，并且希望避免合并冲突时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取我的 NanoClaw 自定义修改，生成迁移指南。
say.note: 开始提取阶段，分析你的修改。

say.text: 用已有的迁移指南升级我的 NanoClaw。
say.note: 跳过提取，直接使用现有指南升级。

say.text: 检查我的 NanoClaw 分支与上游的差异。
say.note: 评估修改范围，决定是否需要完整迁移。

howto.what_en: This skill extracts your customizations from a NanoClaw fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream version and want to avoid merge conflicts.

say_en.text: Extract my NanoClaw customizations and generate a migration guide.
say_en.note: Starts the extraction phase to analyze your changes.

say_en.text: Upgrade my NanoClaw using the existing migration guide.
say_en.note: Skips extraction and uses the existing guide for upgrade.

say_en.text: Check the differences between my NanoClaw fork and upstream.
say_en.note: Assesses the scope of changes to decide if full migration is needed.
